svg.title: SMC reset unit
svg.desc: Internals of smc_reset_unit. Reset inputs enter on the left and the synchronised resets, isolation requests and subsystem controls leave on the right. In u_smc_reset_ctrl, powergood_i is stretched 32 reference clock cycles into powergood_stable, which leaves as powergood_stable_o and holds the cold-reset extender. rst_cold_ni passes a JTAG override mux, a 32-cycle de-glitcher and a 255-cycle extender to form the stable cold reset; the cool-reset pin rst_cool_ni passes a 32-cycle de-glitcher. The primary reset is the AND of the stable cold reset, the de-glitched cool-reset pin and the FLR cool reset. The watchdog reset is the AND of rst_ext_wdt_ni and the inverted SMC watchdog second timeout. The warm reset is the AND of the watchdog reset, the primary reset and fuse_reset_ni after its JTAG override mux, and it passes a further JTAG override mux. u_smc_reset_sync synchronises the watchdog and warm resets to clk_smc_i, the primary reset to clk_ref_i, clk_smc_i and clk_periph_i, and the stable cold reset to clk_ref_i and clk_smc_i. In u_smc_cool_reset_wrap, the rising edge of the synchronised cfg_flr_pf_active_i starts the FLR counters on clk_ref_i, whose FLR cool reset passes a JTAG override mux into the primary reset AND and leaves as rst_cool_no for other chiplets; the same edge sets ISOLATE_REQ_SMC. The isolation logic ORs ISOLATE_REQ_REG, the pin-enabled bits while the synchronised isolate_req_pin_i is high and the SMC-enabled bits while ISOLATE_REQ_SMC is set into isolate_req_o[31:0], and raises skip_mem_repair_o. u_reset_unit_reg, reached over AXI-Lite, holds these registers, drives sync_irq_o and feeds u_smc_subsystem_resets, whose 32 per-subsystem cold and warm resets pass JTAG override muxes into ss_reset_ctrl_o[31:0]; it also drives ss_config_o and samples ss_reset_complete_i. jtag_reset_ctrl_i drives every JTAG override mux, and in test mode scan_rst_ni replaces the stretched powergood, the de-glitched cold reset and every synchroniser output.
svg.text: Test mode: scan_rst_ni replaces powergood_stable, the de-glitched
cold reset and every synchroniser output
